page.layout: One page of text, single column; page number at top centre above an ornament; heading "Liber Secundus." and "CAP. I." above the running text; signature "S 3" at foot left of centre. A small mark at the top left corner is not text. No margin notes.

p.i: In Genef.1.1, nonnulla explicanda & difpicienda proponuntur. Talmudica commenta de mundi inchoati tempore inde eruta. Cabaliftica de Trinitate aliifque eis paria. Talmudica alia de creationis fine, & iftinc, & ex Cap.2.4. Targumifta verfio, à noftris etiam arrepta, rejecta. Rejecta & noftrorum quorundam gemina, ab Hieronymo altera, altera à Tertulliano commemorata. Johannis 8.25. frustra huc trahitur. Veritas à mendacio fuppetias non poftulat. Verficulus Mofis primus enunciatum integrum plerifque, cum novà tamen Petro Picherello fyntaxi. Vir is qantus, qalis : fcripta qa perierint, qa fuperent. Idiotifmus Hebraicus ab illo obfervatus. Hebraeis qibufdam, fed & noftris, enunciati compoliti membrum duntaxat, integrum ratione geminâ conftitutum. בראשית non femper in rectionis ftructurâ. Amos 4.11. fyntaxis qalis, qalis item Efaj.29.1. & Hof.1.1. habitare. bet pro lamed, vel el, ad. Copulativa temporis index, nunc gemina, nunc fimplex. Gen.28.20-22. & Jer.4.1,2. obiter explicata. Grotii verfio altera qâ ratione minus probata. Materia, Hermogeni, Bythos Valentino, res Deo coaterna. Horum cum aliis impia deliria apud noftros refuscitata. Theofophiae novella dogmata iftiusmodi. Rationis examen hujus myftae refugiunt. Sapientiam Dei Salomoni qid effe velint. Lucifer, appellatio non cacodemonis, fed Ch i-fti. Efaj.14.13,14. perperam expofitus. Deum ex nihilo mundum

page.notes: The Hebrew words (בראשית, and the Hebrew word after "Hof.1.1.") and the Greek-looking marks are printed in Hebrew letters; the Hebrew in the line "Amos 4.11" and the Hebrew word "הבית" after Hof.1.1 are only approximate. Left-margin and right-margin text is absent. The last word "mundum" is the catchword and is also repeated at line end; the catchword is printed at the foot right. Some words in the grey lower lines (membrum, compositi) are faint and may be imprecise. The running head is absent.
